name: Exp_Stopreversal
summary: This EA implements a stop-reversal strategy that reverses position direction when price hits a stop level, effectively turning every stop-loss into a new entry signal in the opposite direction. It operates as a systematic mean-reversion system that continuously stays in the market, alternating between long and short positions based on price reaching predefined reversal thresholds.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了止损反转策略，当价格触及止损水平时反转持仓方向，将每次止损转化为反向新入场信号。它作为一种系统性均值回归策略，始终持仓，基于价格达到预定义反转阈值在多头和空头之间交替。
strategy_analysis: 止损反转策略的核心概念是当当前持仓被止损出场时，立即在相反方向开立新仓位，本质上将止损转化为反转信号。入场条件为：当多头仓位被止损平仓后立即开空，当空头仓位被止损平仓后立即开多，始终在市场中保持持仓。出场条件仅依赖止损触发，没有独立的止盈逻辑，盈利完全依赖价格在下次反转前朝有利方向移动足够距离。仓位管理通常使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算，缺乏根据市场波动率动态调整仓位的机制。资金管理方面存在明显不足，因为策略持续持仓且每次反转都产生新交易，在单边趋势行情中会连续止损并反复反转，导致累积亏损风险极大。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在趋势行情中会产生连续亏损，属于典型的均值回归策略特征。
strategy_analysis_en: The stop-reversal strategy's core concept is that when the current position is stopped out, a new position is immediately opened in the opposite direction, effectively converting each stop-loss into a reversal entry signal. Entry conditions are straightforward: when a long position is stopped out, a short is immediately opened, and vice versa, ensuring the EA is always in the market. Exit conditions rely solely on stop-loss triggers with no independent take-profit logic, meaning profitability depends entirely on price moving favorably enough before the next reversal. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or balance-proportional sizing without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility or ATR. Money management is notably lacking as the strategy maintains continuous exposure and generates a new trade on every reversal, creating significant cumulative loss risk during trending markets where consecutive stop-outs and reversals erode capital rapidly. The strategy performs reasonably well in ranging or choppy markets but suffers significant drawdowns in strong trending conditions, which is characteristic of mean-reversion systems.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和实现
在震荡行情中能够捕捉反复波动带来的利润
始终持仓避免了错过行情的问题，确保持续参与市场
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and implement
Can capture profits from repetitive price swings in ranging markets
Always-in-market approach ensures continuous market participation without missing moves
cons: 在强趋势行情中会连续止损反转导致严重亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，无法识别当前市场状态是否适合该策略
没有最大连续亏损次数限制或整体回撤控制，资金安全风险高
cons_en: Suffers severe consecutive losses from repeated stop-and-reverse cycles in strong trending markets
Lacks trend filtering mechanism to identify whether current market conditions suit the strategy
No maximum consecutive loss limit or overall drawdown control, posing high capital safety risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），在强趋势行情中暂停反转交易或调整止损距离
引入最大连续亏损次数限制和整体回撤保护，达到阈值后停止交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX indicator) to pause reversal trading or adjust stop distances during strong trends
Introduce maximum consecutive loss limits and overall drawdown protection that halts trading when thresholds are reached

risk_points: 始终持仓且连续反转机制在趋势行情中会产生连锁亏损
缺少趋势识别和交易暂停机制，无法在不利行情中自我保护
risk_points_en: Always-in-position with continuous reversal mechanism creates cascading losses during trending markets
Missing trend identification and trading pause mechanism provides no self-protection in unfavorable conditions

It operates as a systematic mean-reversion system that continuously stays in the market, alternating between long and short positions based on price reaching predefined reversal thresholds.
